atoms.b: Hi Edmond! I really like your glasses.
Thanks, Charlie! They’re new. I went to the opticians last week. I can see much better now.
atoms.sound: Thanks Charlie! They’re new. I went to the opticians last week. I can see much better now.

atoms.b: I don’t like the opticians, it’s always so boring.
The opticians isn’t my favourite, but I don’t mind going.
My favourite part is when I get sweets at the end!
I like looking at the posters with the letters.

atoms.b: What did you think of the charity store, Cece?
atoms.sound: What did you think of the charity store Cece?

atoms.b: I really loved it! Thanks so much for taking me there. I really like my new sunglasses and earrings. Purple is my favourite colour.
I really like your sunglasses too!
We both bought funky, colourful sunglasses.
I’m glad they had blue sunglasses, that’s my favourite colour! I just wish they had more furniture, I need a new desk.
Don’t worry about it! We can go somewhere else to find a desk for you.
